Find and retrieve tables

Source: R/frontend.R
remote_frontends.Rd

List connectors, find tables, and retrieve data from TosiData. Set up a trusted service connection first; see tosi_options().

  • tosi() with no query lists available connectors and their IDs.

  • tosi_catalog() lists tables provided by one connector.

  • tosi_search() searches for tables across connector catalogs.

  • tosi_data() retrieves a table identified by a data path.

  • tosi_url() retrieves a table or catalog from a supported source URL.

  • tosi_source_reference() retrieves a supported source document.

Catalogs and search results list objects, not observation rows. Use the selected entry's canonical object_path for inspection and retrieval.

Usage

tosi(
  query = NULL,
  source_filter = NULL,
  aggregation = NULL,
  lang = NULL,
  col_mode = c("labels", "safe_labels", "ids"),
  domain_mode = c("labels", "codes"),
  format = "tbl"
)

tosi_data(
  path,
  source_filter = NULL,
  aggregation = NULL,
  lang = NULL,
  col_mode = c("labels", "safe_labels", "ids"),
  domain_mode = c("labels", "codes"),
  format = "tbl"
)

tosi_catalog(connector_id, prefix = NULL, lang = NULL)

tosi_search(search_string, lang = NULL)

tosi_url(
  url,
  lang = NULL,
  col_mode = c("labels", "safe_labels", "ids"),
  domain_mode = c("labels", "codes"),
  format = "tbl"
)

tosi_source_reference(reference, lang = NULL)

Arguments

query

A connector ID, data path, URL, source-reference path, or search string. Omit it or use NULL to list available connectors.

source_filter

Optional selection of source values, series, or rows to retrieve. The accepted format and defaults depend on the connector. See tosi_help() for connector-specific instructions.

aggregation

Optional named list selecting source classifications or aggregation levels by dimension. On connectors that support it, use tosi_aggregation_options(path) to inspect available choices. See tosi_help() for connector-specific instructions and examples.

lang

Optional explicit result language. A non-NULL value overrides the session preference for that call.

col_mode

Column naming mode:

  • "labels" (default) uses column labels.

  • "safe_labels" simplifies labels to ASCII letters, digits, and underscores.

  • "ids" uses column IDs.

This changes column names, not the values in the columns.

domain_mode

For data retrieval, "labels" (default) requests labels in dimension cells, and "codes" requests source codes where supported. Unlike col_mode, this changes cell values, not column names.

format

Output format for data retrieval. Use "tbl" to get a tosi_table in R.

path

A data path beginning with a connector ID and /, followed by a canonical object ID or a supported source identifier or path. Use the object_path returned by catalogs and searches directly for retrieval and inspection.

connector_id

A connector identifier.

prefix

Keep catalog entries whose canonical object IDs start with this prefix. Matching ignores case and does not search table titles.

search_string

Search terms.

url

A source URL recognized by a connector.

reference

A platform source-reference URI from a card's $uri in metadata$source_references, or its connector_id/reference_id path. Open external HTTP(S) references as links; tosi_source_reference() does not fetch them.

Value

  • tosi() returns one of the following, depending on query:

    • No query or NULL: a tosi_connector_catalog tibble listing connectors.

    • A connector ID, catalog prefix, or supported catalog URL: a tosi_dataset_catalog tibble listing tables.

    • A data path identifying a table or a supported table URL: a tosi_table containing the data.

    • Search terms: a tosi_search_results tibble of matching tables.

    • A source-reference path: a TosiSourceDocument.

  • tosi_data(): a tosi_table, a tibble with an embedded schema. Check its result_scope before using the rows as complete data.

  • tosi_url(): a tosi_table or catalog result.

  • tosi_catalog(): a tosi_dataset_catalog tibble.

  • tosi_search(): a tosi_search_results tibble.

  • tosi_source_reference(): a resolved TosiSourceDocument, distinct from the compact TosiSourceReference cards included in other results.

Smart queries with tosi()

tosi(query) routes the query based on what you supply:

  • Connector ID: tosi("eurostat") lists the connector's tables.

  • Data path: tosi("eurostat/sdg_07_40") retrieves the table's data.

  • Source URL: a supported HTTP(S) URL can identify a table or a catalog.

  • Search terms: tosi("renewable energy") searches connector catalogs.

  • Source-reference path: source-reference/<connector>/<reference> retrieves the referenced document, where supported.

Where a connector supports browsing by partial path, a path that matches a prefix but not an exact table returns a catalog, even if it lists only one table. Use tosi_data() when you need a table: an unresolved path raises an error rather than returning a catalog.

Select observations

source_filter selects source values, series, or rows. aggregation selects source-provided classifications or levels, not a calculation over the returned rows. See tosi_help() for available connector instructions and tosi_aggregation_options() for supported choices. Pass the same selections to tosi_schema() to inspect the proposed request.

For a source URL, use tosi() with source_filter or aggregation if you need explicit selections. tosi_url() does not take these arguments.

Result language

For data retrieval, request one language, for example lang = "en" for English. An explicit language overrides a language indicated by a source URL without changing your session preferences. If neither is given, TosiData uses the first available language in your tosi_options() preferences, or the source's default. The connector listing shows languages for each connector, not necessarily for every table it provides.

In tosi_catalog(), lang = c("fi", "en") keeps existing Finnish and English catalog labels, and lang = "all_languages" keeps all available labels. This does not request multiple copies of the table data. In tosi_search(), lang controls which labels are displayed, not which languages are searched.

See also

tosi_options() for connection setup, tosi_metadata() for inspection, and tosi_help() for available connector instructions.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# After setting up a trusted connection (see ?tosi_options):
tosi()
tosi_search("renewable energy", lang = "en")
tosi_catalog("eurostat", prefix = "sdg_07_40", lang = "en")

# Use the object_path of the catalog entry you want.
path <- "eurostat/sdg_07_40"
data <- tosi_data(path, lang = "en")
attr(data, "result_scope")
} # }
